REFERENCE INFORMATION
FUEL SYSTEM

Carefully inspect the body connector end of
the hamess for a short. Check for pushed
out pins, broken or stripped insulation or any
other bare wires. If everything checks out
OK, you have to replace the harness.
Remember to reconnect any wires that may
have been disconnected during
troubleshooting.
For repair instructions (HARNESS REPAIR),
refer to (para 4-85).
For repair/replace instructions (ROTARY
SWITCH), refer to (para 4-7).
